implementation.source: Thin extension host calls native GET /v1/vcs/status; C++ remains the source of Git data and workspace authority.
implementation.workspace_binding: Uses the currently opened and admitted xMind workspace; revalidates its backend ticket after the read.
implementation.display: QuickPick rows show each changed path, native status and exact added/deleted line counts. Empty results avoid claiming a repository exists.
